phase: Dynamic follow-up queue. Asked questions are removed permanently from the current thread (marked ASKED, tracked by text + semantic intentKey); each successful answer replenishes the visible queue back to TARGET_COUNT=3 by retaining surviving unasked items, then merging fresh server candidates, then depth-ordered deterministics — never re-offering an asked question or an already-present/asked intent. Depth level advances monotonically (direction→constraint→validation→first_result→repeatability→scale). New topic expires the previous thread's queue. Quota: tapping a follow-up does not consume; only a completed answer does; when quota hits 0 the wall shows next directions and blocks further free sends.
scope: pages/ai-chat/followupOwnership.js (dynamic queue: asked history, intent dedup, refill, depth, expire) + pages/ai-chat/ai-chat.js (asked/pending/depth state, consumeOnTap, refillQueue on success, quota-exhausted reset) + tests/rc8.11/stage2d-dynamic-queue.test.js (new, matrix A-I + depth) + tests/rc8.11/stage2d-followup-ui.test.js (ladder role/intent split) + tests/rc8.11/run.js + .changes/current-change.json. No server logic, payment, membership, memory, RAW_6Q, replay, profile, or free-3 quota change.
